name: Keep the map dominant
do: Give the map most of the viewport → sidebar under 30%
dont: Do not cover the map with panels
why: The map is the primary content

name: Never rely on color alone
do: Pair color with shape or pattern
dont: Do not encode status by hue only
why: Roughly 8% of men have color vision deficiency
checklist: Is every color-coded status also encoded by shape, label or pattern?

name: Legend stays visible
do:
Show legend,
keep it visible while panning
dont: Hide the legend in a menu
why: Users need the key to read symbols
